limitations: PASS is restricted to these six hash-bound saved English desktop images. Mobile, Chinese, other lessons, browser interaction, and subsequent renders were not inspected.

The tall whole-lesson preview supports composition and visible continuity, not exhaustive inspection of every prose glyph, inline subscript, font rasterization detail, or caption antialiasing. Dedicated figure views support practical label readability, not exact embedded-raster or platform-glyph certification.

The definitionScreenshot is an already-saved top viewport; its lower edge cuts the continuing Figure 178. This is a capture boundary, not a reviewer-created crop. Figure 178 is complete in the whole and dedicated saved images.
The images come from isolated offline headless native course HTML. No browser was opened here; this is not headed acceptance, production verification, or a full interactive-course approval.
Machine Chinese ARIA labels remain disclosed in the report. Visible English captions do not certify English screen-reader labels, ARIA behavior, or complete English accessibility.
DOM counts, media width, and label-size assertions are inherited report evidence, not substitutes for the six actual pixel inspections and not independently re-executed.

Passed original-source, science, translation, and figure gates are reused as authorized. No original figures, source pages, figure specifications, artwork source, or lesson source payloads were opened or re-certified; only current display framing and construction layout were judged.
